title: Hunch demo
notes: Single source for timing, voiceover, captions and overlays. Seconds everywhere.
Scenes must be contiguous: each start equals the previous end. The composition length is the last end.
Traction placeholders {players} {calls} {leader} {leaderEdge} are filled by voiceover.ts (words) and by Remotion (digits).
Clips: video/capture/<clip>.mp4, portrait iPhone screen recordings. clipIn = seconds skipped from the start of the clip (the 2 second hold). rate = playback speed.
Captions are spread across the scene in proportion to their length. Edit the chunks, not the timing.

scenes.voiceover: Argentina to win the final. Fifty dollars. Gone in extra time. A hat trick that never came. Fifty more, gone. The market had Spain at sixty-one percent. Your gut never told you that.
captions: Argentina to win the final. Fifty dollars. Gone in extra time.
A hat trick that never came. Fifty more, gone.
The market had Spain at sixty-one percent.
Your gut never told you that.

scenes.voiceover: Hunch lets you test your gut for a dollar, before you trust it with fifty.
captions: Hunch lets you test your gut for a dollar, before you trust it with fifty.
scenes.overlay: Test your gut for a dollar

scenes.voiceover: Every card is a live market from Gemini's prediction API. You call it before you see the odds. Then Hunch shows you what the market thinks, and what a dollar pays if you're right. Pick how long you want to wait: five minutes, tomorrow, or this week.
captions: Every card is a live market from Gemini's prediction API.
You call it before you see the odds.
Then Hunch shows you what the market thinks, and what a dollar pays if you're right.
Pick how long you want to wait: five minutes, tomorrow, or this week.
scenes.overlay: Call it blind. Then see the odds.

scenes.voiceover: Each swipe places a real one-dollar order on Gemini's exchange sandbox, signed by our server. Five-minute Bitcoin markets settle before you close the app.
captions: Each swipe places a real one-dollar order on Gemini's exchange sandbox, signed by our server.
Five-minute Bitcoin markets settle before you close the app.
scenes.overlay: A real $1 order on every swipe

scenes.voiceover: Copying the crowd scores zero. Being right when the market was wrong scores points, and points are the only way to raise your limit. Everyone starts at a dollar. You earn two, then three, by beating the market, and you drop back the moment you stop.
captions: Being right when the market was wrong scores points, and points are the only way to raise your limit.

and you drop back the moment you stop.
scenes.overlay: Lose your edge, lose the level.
